items.text: Fixed footstep sounds when turning, restoring proper audio feedback while moving.
Resolved an issue where clothing items could not be inserted correctly, fixing related inventory bugs.
Fixed skins not applying to thrown weapons during flight, ensuring projectile appearances match their skins.
Corrected the drag‑and‑drop behavior on the Recycle Bin workbench upgrade so items swap correctly instead of showing an erroneous "Container does not accept player items!" message.
Fixed a bug where catapult projectiles could clip off‑map, restoring proper trajectory and impact behavior.
Fixed invisible building blocks, ensuring all placed structures are visible to players.

Refined mission interactions: hold‑E mission actions now lock movement and camera, progress is target‑anchored and resets on cancellation. Ledger and maintenance‑log reads now take five seconds and only consume repair materials upon completion.
Added loot reveal during extraction missions, showing players what they’ll receive.
Extraction balloons now appear on the map with a countdown timer and close sequentially.
Main inventory size on the extraction map reduced by 50%, limiting how much can be carried during extraction.
Introduced scout drones that patrol small monuments, raise alarms, and can perform exterior searches.
Drones now emit a visible light, conduct searches, and have health that can be damaged.
Added combat capabilities: 4‑second wind‑up flashing/beeping, dodgeable charges dealing 55 damage, and mid‑fight strike behavior.
Each enemy type, including monument guards, now drops its own tiered reward.
Monument guards are tiered; weaker factions now fall under scientists, affecting guard strength.
Guard loot is now tier‑based, and a bug where a dying heavy could drop the client has been fixed.
Raids can no longer be started without a raid map, preventing crashes.
The Outpost is excluded from the raid map, changing where players can travel.
Upon arriving at the hub, players receive dedicated markers, no map overlay, and no death screen.
Safe‑pocket items are now counted as carried inventory and the map is cleared after a raid ends.
Players are prevented from deploying structures while crafting, fixing an exploit.
All items now have a displayed scrap value, letting players see loot worth at a glance.
Loot pricing now reflects item type; furniture has its own contents, and blueprints now have weight, affecting carry limits.
Supplies shop prices increased, every item now has a value, and loot drops above crafted gear are now possible.
Hotbar now shows action progress bars for ongoing tasks.
First loot item now appears instantly in the UI, and hotbar outlines have been removed for a cleaner look.
Show the safe pocket next to whatever is being looted.
Show a reload bar beside the weapon in the shoulder camera view.
Added the Outpost marker and populated the extraction map with additional monuments.
Bank extracted loot in a stash and spawn raiders at raid start.
Added a new 3 km procedural map scene for extraction raids.
Fixed CH‑47 crate landing on top of the powerline pole at the powerplant.
Rail system bugs fixed: floating rails at junctions are lifted, buried tracks are raised by the new Rail Lift stage, and shore ice no longer spawns on rail topology.
Nuclear Missile Silo entrances and underground tunnels no longer clip through terrain while preserving auto‑lowering behavior.
Apartment building collision bounds increased to prevent placement issues.
New missions added and unlocked: Water Treatment Plant mission becomes available after completing Oxum's, and the Bradley APC boss mission is introduced at an abandoned military base.
Fog of war overhauled: now uses a depth‑based camera effect that darkens props, grass and buildings, with map edges staying dark; also includes a padded ground‑overlay version.
Balance tweak: Oxum's bandits and their leader now carry Eokas dealing 3‑5 damage, preventing them from one‑shotting squads.
Island map refreshed: regenerated terrain from Hapis Island with correct sea level, readable map labels, added cover props and scene rebakes for monuments.

Loadout and UI improvements: soldiers can be redressed without cancelling jobs, injured soldiers rest automatically, resource bar enlarged, bottom‑left log added, and recycler now appears as a drop‑in with burst‑out animation.
Quality‑of‑life tweaks: free invites, stronger bow damage, click‑through cut‑away canopies, plain materials for blend‑layer walls, added clan table on island map, and refined squad lineup visuals.
Crafting UI fix: corrected line‑break issue in the crafting row layout.

2026-11-16.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

- Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.

### Raiding
- Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.

### NPC & AI
- A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.

### Loot & UI
- Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.
